metas.name: Shravani Subramanya
metas.description: To appease her father, Shravani agrees to marry the man he chooses. However, when she uncovers the suitor's sinister intentions, she feigns marriage with Subramanya. But how long will the farce last?

metas.name: SeethaRama
metas.description: Sri Ram, an eligible bachelor, falls in love with Seetha, a single mother. Will the judgemental society allow their bond to grow?

metas.name: Shrirasthu Shubhamasthu
metas.description: Tulasi, a widow, finds a friend and supporter in her daughter-in-law Siri, who stands against her family and society to get Tulasi remarried.

metas.name: Naagini 2
metas.description: The fantasy drama revolves around a shape-shifting female serpent who sets out to take revenge from greedy humans, who killed her love for the sake of naagamani.

metas.name: Bhoomige Bandha Bhagavantha
metas.description: Stressed with life on the personal and professional front, Shiva Prasad, a middle-class man, encounters Lord Shiva in a human form, who guides him through his life's dilemmas.

metas.name: Seetha Vallabha
metas.description: Acchu, the son of a rich business tycoon, falls in love with Gubbi, an orphan. However, they have to fight the societal norms and expectations to stay together.

metas.name: Karna
metas.description: Karna, a gynaecologist, is forced into marriage with a pregnant woman who manipulates him for her own gain. As he battles his stepfamily, he finds solace and hope in Nidhi, his loyal friend and ally.

metas.name: Ninagaagi
metas.description: Rachana dreams of leaving stardom behind, while Krishna ongs for a mother. When fate unites them, will Rachana's mother allow her to trade fame for a family?

metas.name: Gattimela
metas.description: The story revolves around Vedanth and Amulya, 2 people with contradicting personalities, who are constantly at loggerheads whenever they meet. Whether both of them will turn their sour relationship into a loving one forms the rest of the story.
